# Foresight Studio

> Foresight Studio (https://foresightstudio.io) is a local-first visual platform for **Life Sciences Forecasting** and **Strategic Analysis**—purpose-built for **BioPharma Forecasting**, **Pharmaceutical Forecasting**, **Medical Device Forecasting**, and **Diagnostics Forecasting**, with native Monte Carlo simulation and clinical/regulatory stage-gate valuation (rNPV / eNPV / DCF).

Developed by Applied Data Sciences, Inc., Foresight Studio replaces fragile, opaque spreadsheet models and legacy Excel add-ins (such as @RISK or Crystal Ball) with transparent visual driver trees, influence diagrams, built-in demographic databases, adoption curves (Bass diffusion, CAGR, dynamic market share), multi-iteration Monte Carlo simulation, and stage-gated clinical/regulatory decision trees.

## Industry Solutions & Forecasting Verticals

- **Life Sciences Forecasting**: Unified visual modeling architecture connecting global demographic epidemiology to patient/procedure volumes, adoption curves, market share, pricing, P&L, and Discounted Cash Flow (DCF).
- **Pharmaceutical & BioPharma Forecasting**: Patient-based epidemiology, prevalence/incidence, diagnosis and treatment rates, line-of-therapy progression, Bass Diffusion drug launch curves, gross-to-net pricing, loss of exclusivity (LoE), and Phase 1–3 clinical stage-gate rNPV / eNPV valuation.
- **Medical Device Forecasting**: Inpatient, outpatient, and ASC surgical procedure-volume epidemiology, hospital capital equipment installed-base expansion, recurring single-use disposable/consumable pull-through utilization, 510(k) / De Novo / PMA regulatory timelines, and tender/ASP erosion.
- **Diagnostics Forecasting (IVD, LDT & Companion Diagnostics)**: Guideline-eligible screening and symptomatic testing flows, clinical analyzer placement and reagent-rental economics, per-instrument assay menu utilization, and Companion Diagnostic (CDx) biomarker co-development attach rates.
- **Strategic Analysis & Portfolio Valuation**: Probabilistic Monte Carlo simulation (P10/P50/P90 confidence bands), deterministic and stochastic tornado sensitivity charts, side-by-side scenario war-gaming, BD&L licensing and M&A deal valuation, and real-options decision trees.

## Core Capabilities

- **Visual Node Graph & Driver Tree Modeling**: Construct transparent epidemiology, patient-flow, procedure-volume, market share, pricing, revenue, expense, P&L, and DCF models on an interactive visual canvas rather than buried spreadsheet formulas.
- **Demographic & Adoption Curves**: Built-in US & global population demographics (227 countries/regions by age, sex, and year), CAGR projections, Bass Diffusion adoption curves, proration, and competitor market share nodes.
- **Probabilistic Risk & Monte Carlo Simulation**: Native PERT (Min/Mode/Max), Normal, Beta, Triangular, Weibull, and LogNormal probability distributions; multi-iteration Monte Carlo engine; P10/P50/P90 fan charts; and deterministic + stochastic tornado sensitivity charts.
- **Clinical & Regulatory Decision Science (rNPV & eNPV)**: Time-aware decision trees modeling Phase 1–3, NDA/BLA, 510(k)/PMA, and IVD approval stage gates, continuous WACC discounting, real options valuation, and risk-adjusted Net Present Value (rNPV / eNPV).
- **100% Local-First Data Privacy**: Native desktop application for macOS (Apple Silicon ARM64) and Windows (x64). Proprietary clinical trial assumptions, medical device pipeline data, BD&L deal terms, and commercial forecast files remain strictly on the user's local machine.

## Pricing & Free Trial

- **7-Day Free Trial**: Full access to the highest tier (**Strategic Analysis Lab**) for 7 days on macOS and Windows with no credit card required (`https://foresightstudio.io/dashboard?mode=signup`).
- **Analyst Plan ($79.99/month)**: Core Financial & Commercial Forecasting — visual driver tree canvas, curve nodes (CAGR, Bass Diffusion, Market Share), P&L and DCF valuation, deterministic scenario sweeps, and tornado sensitivity analysis.
- **Pro Plan ($99.99/month)**: Adds Probabilistic Risk & Monte Carlo Simulation — PERT and full probability distribution library, multi-iteration Monte Carlo engine, P10/P50/P90 confidence intervals, stochastic tornado charts, and multi-tab Excel (`.xlsx`) executive dashboard export.
- **Strategic Analysis Lab Plan ($299.99/month)**: Adds Clinical & Regulatory Decision Science & Real Options — time-aware development pathway decision trees, stage-gated transition probabilities, continuous WACC discounting, real options, and expected / risk-adjusted NPV (eNPV / rNPV).
